name: Alerts Management API
description:
The Alerts API allows you to fetch, update, and comment on security alerts from Cyble Vision. 
It provides advanced filtering, service discovery, and metadata endpoints.

**Authentication:** All endpoints require Bearer token authentication in the Authorization header.

**Date Format:** All dates are in UTC, ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ
